Messages.Author: David Wilson, Mask of a Thousand Names
Messages.Body:
Timing Question:

I have Heidelberg Castle in play. Gratiano has a Baltimore Purge and
it is my untap phase.

Requires a ready vampire. If this vampire is Ravnos, this action is at
+1 stealth. Put this card on the acting vampire. During your untap
phase, burn this card, and each other Methuselah chooses a ready
vampire he or she controls who is not older than this vampire. If you
control a ready Lasombra, you choose the vampires instead. This vampire
and the chosen vampires go to torpor.

Is there time after the *choice* and before the *chosen vampires go to
torpor* to tap the Heidelberg Castle?

The use of the Heidelberg is not during an action, so I do not see why
not. I just wanted to make sure,

David Wilson

I'm not sure I find your answer as strange as David seems to. But I
do think it clearly matters: I imagine David is considering the case
of a Methuselah who wants to use the Heidelberg prior to the effect
of the purge (likely to remove equipment, retainers, and/or blood from
a minion destined for torpor) but also wants the information gleened
from the decisions made in order to know which little piggies are going
to torpor and which ones are staying home.

Fred

Messages.Body:

> of a Methuselah who wants to use the Heidelberg prior to the effect
> of the purge (likely to remove equipment, retainers, and/or blood from
> a minion destined for torpor) but also wants the information gleened
> from the decisions made in order to know which little piggies are going
> to torpor and which ones are staying home.

David's case was one where the Methuselah with the Purge and a Lasombra
controlled the Castle, so it really doesn't matter -- that Methuselah
makes all the choices.

In your case, though, it would.

In that case, yes, you can tap the Castle after the Purger has
made his or her selections.


